    ys=[a for a,b in cells]; xs=[b for a,b in cells]
    H=ys.max()-ys.min()+3; W=xs.max()-xs.min()+3

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

def comps(g, bgc):
    g = np.array(g)
    bg = (g==bgc)
    lab, n = ndimage.label(~bg)
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        cells = set(map(tuple, np.argwhere(lab==i)))
        cols = g.flat[[r*g.shape[1]+c for r,c in cells]]
        color = set(cols.tolist())
        out.append((color.pop(), cells))
    return out

def mindist(cells, other_cells):
    return min(np.hypot(a[0]-b[0], a[1]-b[1]) for a in cells for b in other_cells)

def analyze(name, inp, outp, bgc):
    g=np.array(inp); o=np.array(outp)
    d = np.argwhere(g!=o)
    changed = set(map(tuple,d))
    cs = comps(inp,bgc)
    # which component contains changed cells
    src=None
    for col,cells in cs:
        if cells & changed: src=(col,cells)
    # isolation: min dist from this comp's cells to all other comps' cells
    others=[c for col,c in cs if c is not src and c!=src[1]]
    alloth=set().union(*[c for col,c in cs if (col,c)!=(src[0],src[1])])
    iso = mindist(src[1], alloth)
    # per-comp isolation ranking
    ranks=[]
    for col,c in cs:
        rest=set().union(*[x for cc,x in cs if x is not c])
        ranks.append((mindist(c,rest), col, min(r for r,_ in c), min(cc for _,cc in c), len(c)))
    ranks.sort(reverse=True)
    print(name, "src color",src[0],"size",len(src[1]),"iso=%.2f"%iso)
    for rk in ranks[:4]: print("   iso=%.2f col=%s topr=%d topc=%d size=%d"%rk)
    return src
